definitions.final: Correct C readout at externally supplied N; final-letter matches can follow earlier errors.
definitions.complete: Every readout through requested N is correct.
definitions.fixed: Separate unchanged Steps=N prompt for each survival/hazard panel.
definitions.intervals: 95% pointwise Wilson for binary graph outcomes; saved range intervals use stratified graph bootstrap.
definitions.stopping: Not applicable: no learned stop head.
definitions.episodes: Observed durations; episodes continuing at N are right-censored.
definitions.recovery: Correct next reference state after a wrong decode; prior-wrong transitions are correlated within graphs.
